title.narrative: Strengthening STEM Education Capacities and Opportunities for Young Women in the English- and Dutch-speaking Caribbean

description.narrative: STEM education is critical to innovation, sustainable development, and resilience in the English- and Dutch-speaking Caribbean. Strengthening STEM capacities and increasing the participation of women and girls in STEM fields are essential to preparing future generations for emerging opportunities and challenges. This initiative aims to support countries in engaging with UNESCO’s STEM Education Framework while empowering female students through mentorship, skills development, and community-based STEM activities. By promoting inclusive and gender-responsive STEM education, the initiative will help build the skills, confidence, and leadership of young women across the region.1. Overall purpose and relevance of the workplan The workplan aims to strengthen STEM education capacities in the English- and Dutch-speaking Caribbean by promoting inclusive and gender-responsive approaches to STEM learning. Through mentorship, skills development, and community engagement, the initiative seeks to empower young women and girls to pursue STEM studies and careers while supporting countries in engaging with UNESCO’s new STEM Education Framework. The workplan contributes to UNESCO’s 43 C/5 priorities related to quality education, gender equality, youth empowerment, and capacity-building in Small Island Developing States (SIDS).
